floater.name: floater_sk_navmesh
floater.title: Navmesh console
floater.floater.string: The census has not run yet.
Nothing built yet.
The weather class is not being built; turn it on below to see it.
The overlay is off; nothing below draws until you turn it on.
Ground — walkable terrain
Object — walkable surface of a build
Submerged — walkable, but under water
Storey — one colour per floor, by storey
Connector — stair or ramp between storeys
Tile seam — joined to the next tile
Tile seam — nothing joined to it
Full cover — taller than your eye height
Half cover — you can shoot over it
Low wall — too low to take cover behind
Wall face — the vertical surface itself, full height
Ledge — a landable drop over this edge
Overhang — nothing below within reach
Drop link — where a ledge lands
Census: the object's own triangles
Census: its convex hull
Census: its bounding box, shape unknown
Census: its rendered shape
Census: still moving, left out of the build
Structure — one colour per cluster

check_box.label: Draw the overlay
check_box.name: overlay_on
check_box.tool_tip: The same switch as Develop > Render Metadata > Navmesh

combo_box.label: Class
combo_box.name: overlay_class
combo_box.tool_tip: Avatar: what you can walk on. Weather: the surfaces snow, rain and puddles settle on, which is a much lower agent and needs building first

check_box.label: Build the weather class
check_box.name: build_weather
check_box.tool_tip: Build the weather class as well as the avatar one. Nothing draws for it until this is on

check_box.label: Colour by storey
check_box.name: show_levels
check_box.tool_tip: A colour per floor of a structure instead of per surface kind

check_box.label: Storey connectors
check_box.name: show_connectors
check_box.tool_tip: Lines from each storey to the ones it connects to. The storey model is still rough, so these land in odd places

check_box.label: Tile seams
check_box.name: show_links
check_box.tool_tip: Colour the edges where tiles meet by whether Detour joined them to the next tile

check_box.label: Walls, cover and ledges
check_box.name: show_walls
check_box.tool_tip: Floor edges by what lies beyond them, with the cover they give and where a drop lands

check_box.label: Wall faces
check_box.name: show_faces
check_box.tool_tip: The vertical surfaces at their full height, which is what Atmo reads. The cover segments above stop at four metres because that is all a cover class can mean

check_box.label: Census shapes
check_box.name: show_census
check_box.tool_tip: The physics shapes the mesh is built from, and the structure each belongs to

check_box.label: X-ray vision
check_box.name: show_xray
check_box.tool_tip: Also draw what is hidden behind geometry, darker and fainter

check_box.label: Draw the world underneath
check_box.name: show_world
check_box.tool_tip: Off wipes the frame, leaving the navmesh on its own

slider.label: Edge width
slider.name: overlay_edge_width
slider.tool_tip: How wide the edges of the walkable surface are drawn. Some drivers refuse anything above one pixel

slider.label: Range (m)
slider.name: overlay_range
slider.tool_tip: How far from you or your camera the overlay is drawn

button.name: mark_button
button.label: Mark what the camera is pointing at
button.tool_tip: Cast from the middle of the screen, mark the hit, and write down everything the census and the navmesh know there. The report goes to the log under SKNavDump
